expected_text_segments:
U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission plans November 9 data roundtable

Why it matters: The SEC says feedback will help staff understand how the market and investing public use machine-understandable data for SI solutions, and how the Commission might better facilitate SI.

Context: The countercase is that this may remain a listening exercise. The announcement describes a discussion and a request for feedback; it supplies no quantified benefits, cost estimates or adopted policy.

Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/us-securities-and-exchange-commission

Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.
